title: Stuttgart Roof-Facet Fragmentation and Rooftop PV Packing: Replication Package
description: Replication package supporting the article 'Quantifying Roof-Facet Fragmentation Effects on Rooftop PV Packing Using LoD2 Geometry: A Controlled Experiment and Stuttgart Pilot'. The archive contains the historical Stuttgart CityGML/ALKIS analytical inputs, geometry-audit and packing code, canonical processed tables, sensitivity and statistical outputs, input-integrity checks, and reproducibility documentation.
